edges.reason: msg.sender selects which balances slot is read and debited, so caller identity controls the funds touched.
The constructor mints INITIAL_SUPPLY into balances[msg.sender] for whoever deploys the contract.
transfer is authorized by the require(_value <= balances[msg.sender]) check derived from the caller address.
transferFrom authorization depends on allowed[_from][msg.sender], i.e. on the caller address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender], granting rights keyed by the caller address.
Constructor assigns INITIAL_SUPPLY into the totalSupply state variable.
Constructor reads the INITIAL_SUPPLY constant to seed totalSupply and balances.
transfer writes the balances mapping for the sender and receiver.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried owner.
transferFrom debits and credits the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance mapping.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
transfer always executes the balance subtraction and addition guarded only by SafeMath assertions.
transferFrom always executes the balance and allowance arithmetic before emitting Transfer.
approve unconditionally overwrites the caller's allowance, enabling the approval front-running race.
_to parameter flows into the transfer credit destination.
_value parameter flows into the transfer debit amount.
_value is the operand of the balance arithmetic inside transfer.
_owner parameter indexes the balances lookup in balanceOf.
_from parameter indexes balances and allowed in transferFrom.
_to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value parameter is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
_value is the operand of the arithmetic on balances and allowed in transferFrom.
_spender parameter keys the allowance written by approve.
_value parameter is stored as the allowance in approve.
_owner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
_spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Named return variable balance carries the balances[_owner] value out of balanceOf.
Named return variable remaining carries the allowed[_owner][_spender] value out of allowance.
